title: Hondo Yakarwiswa neFlying Clay
intro: Munguva yaMuporofita Muhammad asati auya, mutongi ane simba wekuYemen akatanga hondo yakanangana nekuparadza nzvimbo tsvene muMakkah. Muvengi uyu akatungamira hondo yakakura ine nzou dzehondo, achivimba nesimba radzo nehuwandu hwadzo. Zvisinei, rwendo rwavo rwaizongoerekana rwapera sezvo vakasangana nekupindira kwaMwari kusingatarisirwi. Ungaziva here kuti ndiani akatarisana nekurangwa uku kunoshamisa?
clues: Takafamba neuto guru nenzou dzehondo dzine simba tichienda kuimba tsvene
Taida kubvisa nekuparadza nzvimbo yekunamatira yakavakwa nevashumiri veNyasha Dzese
Boka reshiri diki rakatumirwa kuzotirwisa, rakatakura matombo evhu mumiromo nepanzara dzaro
Takasangana neruzha rwakatikanda nematombo, rukatiita zvisaririra zvakatsikwa-tsikwa
Ndaibva kunyika yeYemen uye ndakashanda pasi pemutongi aida kuunza nzvimbo tsvene
Takaitwa muenzaniso weavo vaizoshinga kubvisa nzvimbo tsvene yaAllah
verse: Did He not make their plan into misguidance? (105:2-4)
